text:
maria_partnerships: Heads up — Azure Marketplace PO was rejected by partner procurement due to a tax/jurisdiction mismatch. Partner billing entity != the vendor registration on the marketplace. Sale at risk, need unblock. cc @sam_salesops @lee_finance @jon_legal

sam_salesops: Thanks. Can you paste the PO snippet and the exact rejection message? Also is the partner registered as an EU entity on the marketplace or only a US corp?

maria_partnerships: Rejection message: 'Vendor registration mismatch — billing entity must match marketplace vendor profile.'
PO snippet:
```
PO: 2026-0457
Billing Entity: Acme Partners LLC (US)
Billing Address: 100 Market St, SF, CA
Tax ID: US-EIN-12-3456789
Marketplace Vendor ID: 223344
```
Partner attempted to submit via Marketplace but their vendor profile is the EU subsidiary (Acme Europe S.A.) — mismatch.

lee_finance: Procurement won't process invoices that don't come through the marketplace flow unless vendor provides EU VAT details and our AP team approves. We've had tax hold issues with reverse-charge previously.

jon_legal: If marketplace T&Cs require the invoice to be issued by the registered marketplace vendor entity, two options: partner registers the billing entity to match, or we accept a manual invoice with reverse-charge language and a legal holdback clause. Marketplace may disallow external invoices per their policy.

natalie_pm: Looping AM now. From prior experience they can sometimes accept an amendment but it needs signed paperwork from partner — usually 10-15 business days. Can escalate but not guaranteed.

maria_partnerships: Partner says they can issue a manual invoice to our EU entity with VAT reverse-charge wording today, but procurement insists on a PO routed through the marketplace portal. They won't sign off on external payment without PO trace.

lee_finance: We can accept a manual supplier invoice if AP/tax sign-off is obtained and the invoice contains vendor tax id + reverse-charge wording. We also need supplier registration docs (VAT cert / registration number).

sam_salesops: Two tactical options: 1) push AM to fast-track vendor registration amendment (natalie to escalate) 2) accept manual invoice and hold payment pending marketplace reconciliation. Which is faster to close revenue?

natalie_pm: I've pinged AM and asked for a fast-track; they asked for proof of entity registration docs + the PO sample. If partner can upload EU VAT cert and registration screenshot, AM will try to expedite.

maria_partnerships: Uploaded partner docs to drive: https://redwood.internal/partner-docs/acme-eu (partner gave EU VAT cert and company registry extract). Partner also shared invoice template.

jon_legal: I'll draft short reverse-charge wording and a holdback clause we can add to the invoice acceptance: "Payment subject to successful marketplace registration amendment within 45 days. If not completed, Redwood reserves the right to adjust payment and require corrected invoice." Will circulate.

lee_finance: That works. Also need contact details for vendor AP and tax ID on invoice. If legal + tax ok, AP can process with a 25% holdback until registration completes.

sam_salesops: Procurement confirmed they'd accept an internal PO that references the marketplace deal ID and includes procurement memo explaining exception. I'll prepare the memo and route for approval.

maria_partnerships: Plan agreed: natalie escalate AM; partner to provide EU VAT cert + invoice template (done); legal to provide wording; finance to accept manual invoice with holdback; sam to produce procurement memo so PO can be issued this week. Target: invoice processed before week-end. :crossed_fingers:

natalie_pm: AM responded — escalation accepted. They'll fast-track review if we send the vendor registry screenshot and PO sample (both in drive). I'll follow up with AM + cc @jon_legal.

lee_finance: I'll draft the AP processing checklist and holdback instruction and send to maria & sam by EOD.

maria_partnerships: Thanks all. I'll tell partner we have an interim path (manual invoice + holdback) while natalie works the marketplace amendment. Will update once AP confirms payment.

vendor-billing-bot: SYSTEM: Invoice 2026-0457 uploaded by partner-billing@acme-eu — awaiting AP review.

maria_partnerships: Closing actions: natalie follow AM, jon finalize wording, lee send AP checklist, sam create procurement memo. Will close thread when payment is accepted. :thumbsup:
